{"category_edits":[{"category":"learning_objective","rationale":"Apply an eight-position recency half-life to the existing pairwise plus 0.2-weighted pointwise objective across all four datasets. Normalize by valid weight mass to emphasize recent targets while retaining earlier supervision. Model architecture and inference remain unchanged.","edits":[{"find":"    loss = pairwise_loss + 0.2 * pointwise_loss
    return (loss * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)","replace":"    loss = pairwise_loss + 0.2 * pointwise_loss
    positions = torch.arange(pos.size(1), device=pos.device).expand_as(pos)
    last_valid = positions.masked_fill(pos.eq(0), -1).max(dim=1, keepdim=True).values
    distance = (last_valid - positions).clamp(min=0).to(loss.dtype)
    weights = torch.exp2(-distance / 8.0) * mask
    return (loss * weights).sum() / weights.sum().clamp(min=1.0)"}]}],"change_summary":"Weight valid target losses by exp2(-distance_from_final_valid_target/8), preserving the existing objective coefficients and all training and prediction settings."}
